title: Trend Research Agent Skills to Watch in 2026
summary: Agent skills are turning trend research into repeatable workflows with sources, scoring, and synthesis.
author: OpenAgent.bot Editors
seoTitle: Trend Research Agent Skills to Watch in 2026
seoDescription: Why trend research is becoming a strong use case for AI agent skills, with last30days as a practical example.
body: Trend research is a natural fit for agent skills because the workflow repeats: search recent sources, rank noisy signals, synthesize themes, and preserve uncertainty.
[last30days](/skills/last30days-skill) is a useful example. It turns recent social, developer, market, and web research into an invocable skill rather than a one-off prompt.
## What a good trend skill needs
- A way to separate facts, sentiment, and speculation.
They are useful for product discovery, content planning, market scans, competitive research, open-source scouting, and community pulse checks.
Rerun the same topic across several days, compare output stability, inspect the source links, and check whether the skill notices when evidence is thin.
